| Arabic word | Arabic spelling | Arabic definition (as found in classical / modern Arabic dictionaries) | English equivalent |
|------------|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------|
| **هِنْدُو** | **هِنْدُو** (n.) | *أُنّ من اتبع الديانة الهندوسية؛ هو صاحب أصولٍ هندية أو متبعٍ لأحكام وطقوس الهندوسية.* | *Hindu – a adherent of Hinduism* |
| **هِنْدُوسي** | **هِنْدُوسِيّ** (adj.& n.) | *أُسْمىً أو صَفْحًا يخصّ الأفراد الذين ينتمون إلى الديانة الهندوسية.* | *Hindu – adjectival form (i.e., Hindu person, Hindu religion)* |

#### Short summary

- In Arabic, the term **هِنْدُو** denotes a *person who follows/identifies with the Hindu religion*.  
- The adjectival form **هِنْدُوسِيّ** (hindu‑siy) is used to describe people, things, or concepts related to Hinduism – e.g., “الديانة الهندوسية” (“the Hindu religion”), “الثقافة الهندوسية” (“Hindu culture”).  

So, the word that is also the majority religion in the area that became India (i.e., the word “هِنْدُو / هندوسي” in Arabic) means *a follower of Hinduism*.

### Arabic meaning of the word **هِنْدُو / هندوسي**

| Arabic word | Arabic spelling | Arabic definition (as found in classical / modern Arabic dictionaries) | English equivalent |
|------------|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------|
| **هِنْدُو** | **هِنْدُو** (n.) | *أُنّ من اتبع الديانة الهندوسية؛ هو صاحب أصولٍ هندية أو متبعٍ لأحكام وطقوس الهندوسية.* | *Hindu – a adherent of Hinduism* |
| **هِنْدُوسي** | **هِنْدُوسِيّ** (adj.& n.) | *أُسْمىً أو صَفْحًا يخصّ الأفراد الذين ينتمون إلى الديانة الهندوسية.* | *Hindu – adjectival form (i.e., Hindu person, Hindu religion)* |

#### Short summary

- In Arabic, the term **هِنْدُو** denotes a *person who follows/identifies with the Hindu religion*.  
- The adjectival form **هِنْدُوسِيّ** (hindu‑siy) is used to describe people, things, or concepts related to Hinduism – e.g., “الديانة الهندوسية” (“the Hindu religion”), “الثقافة الهندوسية” (“Hindu culture”).  

So, the word that is also the majority religion in the area that became India (i.e., the word “هِنْدُو / هندوسي” in Arabic) means *a follower of Hinduism*.
